topic: Format chains without own product feed: Billa Plus, Eurospar, Interspar, ADEG

evidence.quote: Der BILLA Online Shop wird um die Sortimente von BILLA PLUS erweitert.
holen Sie mit Click & Collect Ihren Einkauf flexibel in einem BILLA oder BILLA Plus Markt in der Nähe ab

Billa Plus.data: 790/807 Billa rows have a shop.billa.at URL (the one shared BILLA/BILLA PLUS online assortment)
Billa Plus.not_covered: BILLA PLUS in-store counters (Marktküche take-away boxes, Feinkost) are not in any online feed — not indexable

evidence.fact: search-spar.spar-ics.com fact-finder index products_lmos_at = the interspar.at shop index; live 2026-10-25: 'Fertiggericht' totalHits 599, shop-source FOS, URLs interspar.at/shop/lebensmittel/.../p/<id>
INTERSPAR food ordering/pick-up ended 14.12.2025; product catalogue with prices remains on interspar.at (Cloudflare, not requested) and in the search index

Interspar.data: 515/735 Spar rows carry an interspar.at product URL

evidence.quote: SPAR-Produktwelt ... über 35.000 Produkten aus dem SPAR-Sortiment ... in welchen SPAR-, EUROSPAR- oder INTERSPAR-Märkten sie aktuell verfügbar sind
evidence.note: single shared SPAR catalogue; per-market availability lives on spar.at which answers 403 (Cloudflare) to the box — not bypassed

evidence.quote: EUROSPAR-Märkte bieten auf 1.000 bis 2.000 m² ... INTERSPAR ... bis zu 50.000 ... Produkte

Eurospar.per_product_format_flag: impossible: search index field pos-visible holds 1–13 numeric POS ids (e.g. 8757, 8427 …) with no public mapping to EUROSPAR/INTERSPAR formats; not guessed

evidence.quote: Seit Oktober 2022 firmiert die Marke ADEG unter dem Dach der REWE Großhandel GmbH ... Eigenmarken: clever, Ja! Natürlich, efef, Billa immer gut, Billa Bio, Simply Good, ... Chef Menü

evidence.fact: adeg.at has no shop/product API; per-market Issuu flipbooks only

ADEG.data: REWE private-label ready meals ADEG can carry are already indexed under Billa: 322 Billa rows (Billa immer gut, CLEVER, Omis Schmankerl, Simply Good, BILLA Bio, Ja! Natürlich, Vegavita …); ADEG per-market assortment is chosen by independent merchants and not published
